description: issue #677 (SP5): the profile gate for `set_shape`. `set_shape` is a Turtle & Rendering primitive, so with only `core-language` active it is not a visible name and the checker rejects it `ol-unknown-command` (no did-you-mean — no near Core name). The clean counterpart, shape-checks-clean, shows the same command checking clean once `turtle-rendering` (and `sprites`) are active — proving the command is gated on its profile, not hardcoded.
